search-jobs: Your agent goes through the job boards you have enabled in Sources using your browser and adds the jobs it finds. You'll see them in «To review».
process-jobs: Reads the new jobs and extracts their details (role, requirements, salary, work mode…) so they can be filtered and assessed. Needs nothing from you.
assess-fit: Compares each processed job with your profile and leaves an explained assessment on its page. You decide whether to approve or discard it in «To review».
assess-fit-job: Compares this job with your profile and leaves an explained assessment here. If it had an outdated one, it replaces it.
generate-cv: Writes a CV tailored to this job, using only your profile, and checks that nothing is made up. The Word and PDF files are left on the job page.
add-skills: Adds to your profile the skills you marked as «I have it». It shows you the changes and asks before saving.
training-plan: Turns the skills you marked as «I don't have it» into a study plan with verified resources, estimated time and order.
review-replies: Classifies emails from companies (interview, assignment, offer, rejection…) and leaves a proposal on each. The status only changes when you accept it.
draft-follow-ups: Drafts reminders for applications without a reply and thank-you notes after interviews. You copy and send them yourself: the app sends nothing.
draft-follow-up: Drafts a reminder or a thank-you note for this company and leaves it on the job page. You copy and send it yourself: the app sends nothing.
broaden-search: Suggests job titles similar to the ones you already approve (e.g. «BI Engineer») and, with your OK, adds them to your searches. Changes nothing without asking.
prepare-interview: Prepares a PDF guide (the role, your fit, the company, likely questions with answer ideas and what to ask) and a day-by-day plan until the interview.
mock-interview: Asks you questions one at a time, comments on each answer and suggests a better one based on your profile. You answer in the terminal.
debrief-interview: You tell it how it went: it saves notes and next steps on the job page, anticipates the next round and suggests new stories for your profile, added only with your OK.
offer-questions: Goes over the offer you received and lists what to clarify with the company before accepting (terms, role, team…).
prepare-negotiation: Prepares arguments from your profile, questions and a script for negotiating. If you paste the contract, it reviews it clause by clause. It never suggests a figure and is not legal advice.
draft-message: Drafts a LinkedIn message or an email for someone at the company (recruiter, hiring manager or a peer) and leaves it on the job page for you to copy. It is never sent.
research-company: Searches the public web for what the company does, its product, news and engineering culture, and saves a dossier with sources on the job page.
handle-requests: Shows you the tasks you left with «Leave for my next session», does the ones you choose and closes each one when done.
review-search: Retrospective: checks whether the score is right and which sources, templates and habits work, and suggests what to change. It doesn't touch weights or filters: that's your call.
create-profile: Reads the CV you uploaded and fills in your profile section by section. It asks about what the CV doesn't say and saves nothing without your OK.
expand: Reads your public links (GitHub, portfolio, certifications…) and suggests projects, skills and achievements with their source. Writes to your profile only with your OK.
improve-profile-item: Suggests a clearer, more concrete version of this item of your profile, without making anything up. It shows you the change and asks before saving it.
propose-stories: Suggests interview stories (situation, task, action, result) from your experience and achievements. Adds them to your profile only with your OK.
import-cv-template: Turns this uploaded CV into a template with the same design for your next CVs. Lets you compare the result before saving it.
